answer: Concretely, the economy can bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The crystal of work and the velvet of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a raven to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
